method.mode: READ-ONLY inventory. No LLM/model calls were made. No files outside the Arena parallel worktree were written. No processes were signalled.
procedure: Read each repository's own self-description first (README.md, AGENTS.md, RESEARCH_STATE.md, STATUS.json, manifests/) to learn what it CLAIMS to contain.
Verified every claim against the actual files on disk: directory listings level by level, exact `wc -l` counts on JSONL where cheap, `du -sh` for sizes.
For every distinct format, loaded ONE real record and recorded the ACTUAL top-level keys. No schema in this file is guessed.
Established provenance from generator scripts and manifests where available; where provenance is genuinely ambiguous it is recorded as AMBIGUOUS rather than assumed.
Verification status is recorded only where an artifact carries explicit verifier evidence (SymPy certificate, Lean replay certificate, exact-source-match audit).
method.epistemic_rule_applied: Human or LLM reasoning prose is NOT canonical mathematical truth. Every asset is catalogued as ANNOTATION_UNVERIFIED unless it carries an independent verifier result recorded in the data itself.

trust_tiers.VERIFIED_FORMAL: Steps originate from, or were replayed against, a formal proof assistant (Lean/Isabelle) and the artifact records the verifier outcome.
trust_tiers.DETERMINISTICALLY_CHECKED: Steps carry a machine-checkable non-formal certificate (e.g. SymPy solution-set equality, exact byte match against an immutable source, schema/round-trip validation).
trust_tiers.ANNOTATION_UNVERIFIED: Semantics asserted by a human annotator, an LLM, or a curated extraction pipeline with no independent mathematical verifier.

summary_for_operation_vocabulary_discove.headline: There IS a real, high-quality granular reasoning-chain asset — but it is SMALL. The rich schema (per-step operation label + warrant + preconditions + obligations with lifetimes + typed inter-step dependencies + full before/after state) exists for exactly 792 steps: 769 MATH-derived Gold-125/Gold-25 transitions plus 23 hand-authored Gold-10 actions. Everything at 10k-300k scale is either single-operation Lean tactic data, or unverified human step ratings, or synthetic transitions with a degenerate action label.
step_granular_and_scientifically_usable_: data/derived/gold125_ontology_v1/ — 769 atomic transitions, 7 orthogonal semantic axes, uncertainty and annotator disagreement preserved. BEST for vocabulary discovery over natural-language mathematics.
data/gold125 + data/gold25 trajectories — the same 769 steps with FULL before/after structured state, warrants, obligation lifetimes, and typed dependencies. BEST for state-transition semantics.

data/gold_10 + examples/gold_10 — 10 problems / 23 actions, hand-authored, arithmetic-oracle verified, and additionally tagged with a 16-stage sub-sentence decomposition. FINEST GRANULARITY IN THE PROJECT, but tiny.

HML_V3 data/corpus/*.jsonl.gz — ~1,150 freshly elaborated Lean transitions with TYPED AST states and a 19-field structured state delta. BEST structured substrate; no natural language, no warrants; 232 of them are SEALED.
HML_V3 data/micromath_lab_v2/ — 611 sub-atomic relation probes with negative controls and a shortcut-audit gate. BEST existing INSTRUMENT for testing whether a representation exposes a relation.
lean_canonical_records.jsonl — 241,265 formally grounded transitions with a COMPUTED 8-class effect vocabulary. BEST for scale and for an operation signal that is measured rather than asserted.
data/vnext_10k — 10,000 transitions marked FORMAL_REPLAY_VERIFIED with real premises_used lemma lists. BEST verified mid-size set.
synthetic_math/transitions.jsonl — 3,978 atomic natural-language transitions, 867 with SymPy certificates. Cheap volume, but 77% of labels are TRANSFORM.
